g.text: Numbers: command specifier of the NMT message (1 start remote node, 2 stop remote node, 128 enter pre-operational, 129 reset node, 130 reset communication); request: Red_PreopReq.
MinimalSet_g = true: no NMT message is taken; ResetComm_s and WaitId_s lead to Op_s, a request leads Op_s to PreOp_s, the end of the bus selection PreOp_s to Op_s.
The when others branch leads to ResetComm_s.
